prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Joshua P. Davis of Davis Law Group
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” lawyer for every car-wreck case. **Joshua P. Davis of Davis Law Group** is one Houston option to consider: his profile lists car and motor-vehicle accidents among his practice areas and says he is board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. [Super Lawyers profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/texas/houston/lawyer/joshua-p-davis/399a5d08-8f47-4358-bb07-6ff63c6a7252.html)

You could also compare **Paul Hilmon Cannon** at Simmons & Fletcher, whose profile lists car-accident work and the same board certification. [Profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/texas/houston/lawyer/paul-hilmon-cannon/80317f5f-fe80-481e-bc71-c9c773967ad1.html)

Before hiring anyone, ask who will personally handle your case, how often they take car-wreck cases to trial, what the contingency fee and case costs are, and whether they see any conflicts or weaknesses in your claim. You can also request a referral through the **Houston Lawyer Referral Service** listed by the State Bar of Texas: [Texas Bar referral services](https://www.texasbar.com/Content/NavigationMenu/ForThePublic/DoYouNeedaLawyer/CertifiedLawyerReferralServices1/default.htm).
